pages.text: Build an upright frame of vanilla slime blocks in the Overworld. Use the same sizes as a Nether portal: an interior 2–21 blocks wide and 3–21 blocks tall. The smallest outer frame is 4×5. Corners are optional.

Hold a slimeball and right-click a frame face pointing into the empty interior. Activation uses one slimeball in Survival. Stand inside to travel to The Slimic. Existing nearby portals serve as exits; otherwise a safe frame and landing platform are created.

Portals connect the Overworld and The Slimic at a 1:1 coordinate scale. Dismount before entering. A return portal remains at your arrival point. Breaking a required slime frame block closes the portal; repair the frame and activate it again.
